description:
CallTargetSummary.activation_inputs is merged COLUMN-WISE
(merge_summary_input_vec via same_call_target, semantic.rs:1909-1939)
while ActivationInputRow must stay correlated (fz-9i4.7.10.2). Any
edge-carried row model needs a correlated row SET on the edge value.

PROVEN LOAD-BEARINGLY WRONG (2026-08-31, fz-kdt.80 STOP report): the
fz-kdt.80 A1 experiment (publish only the walked identity, drop the
re-mint from the blend) MISCOMPILES -- Enum.take([1,2,3,4,5],3) returns
[1,2,3,4,5] -- direct proof that the column-wise blended surface and a
single walked row's identity cannot coexist on one call target. The blend
is also the input to fz-kdt.80's non-homomorphic re-mint (the union that
mints the wider key IS this column-wise merge). A correlated row carrier
removes the blend at the callsite-summary level.

## Sequencing (2026-08-31)
Shared substrate under BOTH live routes (a resumed fz-kdt.69.3 and any
future cell model) -- not speculative. fz-kdt.80's join-stable-key fix may
shrink this ticket (if the key commutes with union, the blend stops
minting new identities) -- re-verify the residual need after fz-kdt.80
lands. Same-commit rip-out: delete the column-wise merge when the
correlated carrier lands. Acceptance: edge value carries rows; artifact
byte-identical; pins hold. STOP: if carrying rows changes the demanded key
set, that is the artifact-vs-precision tension surfacing (fz-kdt.74 item
5) -- stop and decide the artifact question explicitly.
